done_when: tests/test_discovery.py has one test where a project with nothing on its roadmap also has a spec whose success check is due, and forge next prints the due check before the discovery prompt

findings.body: The branch only adds fix-tracking metadata; it does not add the required test. In tests/test_discovery.py, the existing discovery test invokes `forge next` at line 75 without creating a spec with a due success check. None of the file's three tests exercises the combined scenario or asserts output ordering. Add a collected test that creates an empty-roadmap project and a spec with a due success check, invokes the real command, and asserts that both messages appear with the due check before the discovery prompt.
